title: WebGPU Omnidirectional Shadow Mapping in Rust
description: Render point-light shadows in every direction with Rust and WebGPU. Build a six-face 1024×1024 floating-point cube map, store radial distance, and shade a room.
imageAlt: Four colored teapots inside a three-walled room, lit by a small moving point light and casting shadows in several directions.
